title: Death at the Sangeet
call: Inspector {name}, Uncle Raj is dead at his nephew's wedding.
400 guests, and nobody saw a thing. Find the killer before morning.
arrival: The sangeet music has stopped. Everyone is waiting outside.

briefing.label: Victim
briefing.value: Uncle Raj, 62. Rich, and the groom's uncle.

examination.title: Examine the body

spots.title: Mouth
spots.text: No wounds anywhere. His lips smell bitter, like medicine.

spots.title: Right hand
spots.text: He's holding an empty sweet wrapper, round, with tiny yellow crumbs. Where's the sweet?

spots.title: Pocket
spots.text: A note: "I've changed my will. All my money goes to the temple. – Raj"

examination.question: How did Uncle Raj die?
examination.why: No wounds, bitter lips, and a sweet in his hand. Someone poisoned his sweet.

interview.alibi: I was getting my bridal mehndi done all night!
replies: Yes, I'm family. But Aunty Kamala was doing my mehndi for 3 hours!
That's not my key. My car keys are with my father tonight.
interview.release: Aunty Kamala was doing Priya's mehndi all night.

interview.alibi: I was on the stage for photos all night!
replies: I'm family, but I never left the stage.
My sunglasses? They're right here, on my head.
My car key is right here, in my pocket.
interview.release: 400 guests saw Arjun on the stage all night.

interview.alibi: I was in the parking lot, on a long phone call.
replies: A laddu? I don't even eat sweets.
gotchas: Where are your sunglasses, Vikram? They were by the chilli powder, covered in mud!
This muddy key opens YOUR car, Vikram!

leads.from: ✋ The sweet wrapper in his hand
leads.question: The wrapper is round, with tiny yellow crumbs inside. Which sweet was in it?
wrongWhy: Jalebi is long and twisty, not round.
Gulab jamun is brown and syrupy, not crumbly.
leads.reveal: A laddu! Pandu digs through the dustbin…
leads.name: Half-eaten laddu
leads.found: In the dustbin, hidden under vegetable peels. Its wrapper says **"Sharma FAMILY – special laddu"**. Only family got these. It also smells of red chilli.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone who is NOT family.
leads.why: These laddus were only for the family.

leads.from: 🟠 The laddu smells of red chilli
leads.question: Laddus are sweet. So why does this one smell of red chilli? What was the poison mixed into?
leads.reveal: Chilli powder! Its strong taste hides the poison. You check the spice rack…
leads.name: Sunglasses
leads.found: A pair of **sunglasses** next to the chilli powder. There's **wet mud** on them.
leads.ask: Tap everyone left who wears sunglasses.
leads.why: Arjun and Vikram both wear sunglasses. You'll have to question them.
leads.card: SUNGLASSES left by the chilli powder

leads.question: There's wet mud on the sunglasses, but the kitchen floor is dry. Where had the killer been?
wrongWhy: The stage has a carpet. No mud there.
leads.reveal: Outside, in the wet garden! You open the back door…
leads.name: Car key
leads.found: A muddy **car key**, dropped on the back step in a hurry.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone left who does NOT drive a car.
leads.why: The killer drives a car. Aunty Kamala came by auto.
leads.card: A muddy CAR KEY at the back door

confession: "Uncle Raj was giving all his money to the temple. I only wanted my share."
escapeStory: Cousin Vikram got away. Airport police caught him two days later. "I only wanted my share of the money."
